soalan: Read the text. 'Hello! My name is Aisyah. I am twelve years old. I have got a big family and two pet cats.' How old is Aisyah?
maklum_balas: The text says 'I am twelve years old', so the answer is C.

soalan: Read the sentence: 'My brother is very friendly. He likes to talk to new people.' The word 'friendly' means someone who is ______.
pilihan: nice and easy to talk to
maklum_balas: 'Friendly' means kind and easy to talk to, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
maklum_balas: A sentence begins with a capital letter and a name is capitalised, and it ends with a full stop, so B is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling of the high-frequency word is 'friend', so C is correct.

soalan: Which sentence uses a question mark correctly?
maklum_balas: A question needs a capital letter at the start and a question mark at the end, so A is correct.

soalan: Read: 'This is my classroom. There are 30 desks and a big whiteboard. Our teacher is Mr Lim.' What is the text mainly about?
maklum_balas: The text describes desks, a whiteboard and a teacher, so the main idea is a classroom (B).

soalan: You meet a new classmate. Which is the best way to ask for their name politely?
maklum_balas: 'What is your name, please?' is polite and correct, so B is the best choice.

soalan: Choose the correct verb: 'I ______ two sisters and one brother.'
maklum_balas: With 'I' we use 'have got', so B is correct.

soalan: Your teacher asks: 'Where are you from?' What is the correct answer?
maklum_balas: The question asks about place, so 'I am from Penang' (B) is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with commas used correctly in a list.
pilihan: I like apples oranges and pears.
I like apples, oranges and pears.
I, like apples oranges and pears.
I like, apples oranges, and pears.
maklum_balas: Commas separate items in a list, so B is correct.

soalan: Read the short chat. Ben: 'Hi, I am Ben. Nice to meet you.' Sara: '______' Which reply fits best?
pilihan: Nice to meet you too, Ben.
maklum_balas: A friendly greeting is answered with 'Nice to meet you too', so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Mila never forgets her books. She always finishes her homework early.' Which word best describes Mila?
maklum_balas: Because she remembers her books and finishes homework, she is responsible, so C is the best inference.

soalan: Choose the best word to join the two ideas: 'I like art ______ I am not good at drawing.'
maklum_balas: The two ideas contrast, so 'but' (B) links them best.

soalan: Read: 'On his first day, Aziz stood at the gate. His hands were shaking and he did not smile.' How does Aziz most likely feel?
maklum_balas: Shaking hands and no smile show he feels nervous, so C is the best answer.

soalan: Read: 'Farid loves football. He plays it every weekend with his friends at the park.' What does Farid like doing?
maklum_balas: The text says he loves football and plays every weekend, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct present simple verb: 'She ______ pop music.'
maklum_balas: With 'she' the verb takes an -s, so 'likes' (B) is correct.

soalan: 'My favourite hobby is collecting stamps.' The word 'hobby' means ______.
pilihan: a job you get paid for
an activity you enjoy in free time
maklum_balas: A hobby is a free-time activity you enjoy, so C is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'favourite' (British English), so B is correct.

soalan: Listen/read: 'I don't like spicy food, but I love sweet cakes.' What does the speaker love?
maklum_balas: The speaker loves sweet cakes, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct question: '______ you like swimming?'
maklum_balas: With 'you' we use 'Do' in the present simple, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct adverb of frequency: 'I ______ play video games. I play them every single day.'
maklum_balas: 'Every single day' means 'always', so B is correct.

soalan: Your friend asks: 'What do you like doing in your free time?' Which is the best full answer?
maklum_balas: The question asks about activities, so a full answer naming activities (B) is best.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
maklum_balas: A question starts with a capital and ends with a question mark, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Lina spends her pocket money on comic books. She saves the rest.' What does Lina spend her money on?
maklum_balas: The text says she spends money on comic books, so B is correct.

soalan: Read the reply: 'How often do you go to the cinema?' 'About once a month.' How often does the person go?
maklum_balas: 'Once a month' is stated, so C is correct.

soalan: Which sentence uses the present continuous correctly to describe an activity happening now?
pilihan: He is watching a film now.
maklum_balas: The present continuous 'is watching' shows an action happening now, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Sam tries every new sport at school. He is keen to learn anything active.' The word 'keen' shows that Sam is ______.
maklum_balas: 'Keen' means very interested, so B is the best meaning.

soalan: Read: 'Priya smiled widely and hugged her new bike. She could not wait to ride it.' How does Priya feel about her bike?
maklum_balas: Her wide smile and hug show she feels delighted, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The film is about a robot that helps a young boy solve a mystery.' Who does the robot help?
maklum_balas: The text says the robot helps a young boy, so A is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct past simple verb: 'Yesterday we ______ an exciting story.'
maklum_balas: The past simple of 'read' is 'read' (same spelling), so A is correct for 'yesterday'.

soalan: 'The story is fiction, not a true report.' The word 'fiction' means a story that is ______.
maklum_balas: 'Fiction' means an imagined, made-up story, so B is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'character', so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct past simple verb: 'The hero ______ to the castle last night.'
maklum_balas: The irregular past simple of 'go' is 'went', so C is correct.

soalan: Read the start of a story: 'Once upon a time, a clever fox lived in a green forest.' Where did the fox live?
pilihan: in a cave by the sea
maklum_balas: The text says the fox lived in a green forest, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct past simple form: 'She ______ a strange noise and turned around.'
maklum_balas: The irregular past simple of 'hear' is 'heard', so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'This article gives real facts about how newspapers check their stories before printing.' What type of text is this?
maklum_balas: Real facts about newspapers make this a non-fiction article, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with speech marks used correctly.
pilihan: Ali said, I saw the show.
Ali said I saw the show."
maklum_balas: Speech marks go around the spoken words, so A is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The news report said the story about a flying car was false.' Was the flying car story true?
maklum_balas: The report said the story was false, so B is correct.

soalan: Put the events in the correct order: 'First he woke up. Then he ate breakfast. Finally he ______ to school.'
maklum_balas: A past narrative uses 'went', so C is correct.

soalan: Which sentence is correct in the past simple?
maklum_balas: After 'didn't' we use the base verb 'believe', so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The witness insisted her story was true, even when nobody trusted her.' The word 'insisted' shows she ______.
maklum_balas: 'Insisted' means she said it firmly and would not change, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Captain Nara never gave up. She led her crew through the storm and kept everyone calm.' Which words best describe Captain Nara?
maklum_balas: Leading the crew and staying calm show she is brave and calm, so A is correct.

soalan: Read: 'A storm hit the town. Strong winds broke trees and heavy rain flooded the roads.' What did the heavy rain do?
maklum_balas: The text says heavy rain flooded the roads, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct comparative: 'Today is ______ than yesterday.'
maklum_balas: The comparative of 'hot' is 'hotter', so B is correct.

soalan: 'There was a drought, so the rivers dried up.' The word 'drought' means a long time with ______.
maklum_balas: A drought is a long dry period with no rain, so B is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'weather', so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct superlative: 'It was the ______ day of the whole year.'
maklum_balas: The superlative of 'cold' is 'coldest', so C is correct.

soalan: Read the forecast: 'Tomorrow will be sunny in the morning and windy in the afternoon.' What will the afternoon be like?
maklum_balas: The forecast says the afternoon will be windy, so C is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct comparative: 'A hurricane is ______ dangerous than light rain.'
maklum_balas: We say 'much more dangerous' for a bigger difference, so A is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Floods can damage homes and crops. People should move to higher ground and listen to the news.' What is the main advice?
maklum_balas: The main advice is to move to higher ground, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters.
pilihan: the storm hit kuala lumpur on monday.
The storm hit Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
the Storm hit Kuala lumpur on monday.
The storm hit kuala Lumpur on Monday.
maklum_balas: The first word, the place and the day all need capitals, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The temperature rose to 39 degrees. It was the hottest week in ten years.' How hot did it get?
maklum_balas: The text states 39 degrees, so B is correct.

soalan: Your friend goes out in a thunderstorm. What is the best advice?
pilihan: You should stay indoors until it is safe.
You must swim in the river now.
You should stand under a tall tree.
You can fly a kite in the storm.
maklum_balas: Staying indoors is safe and sensible advice, so A is correct.

soalan: Which sentence is correct?
pilihan: Deserts are the driest place on Earth.
Deserts are the driest places on Earth.
Deserts are the more dry places on Earth.
Deserts are driest place on Earth.
maklum_balas: The superlative 'the driest places' with a plural noun is correct, so B is right.

soalan: Read: 'The wind was so fierce that it lifted roofs off houses.' The word 'fierce' here means ______.
maklum_balas: Lifting roofs shows the wind was very strong, so 'fierce' means violent (B).

soalan: Read this poem line: 'The angry sky roared and threw its silver spears of rain.' What does the poet want us to feel about the storm?
pilihan: that it is calm and quiet
that it is powerful and frightening
that it is warm and friendly
maklum_balas: Words like 'angry', 'roared' and 'spears' make the storm feel powerful and frightening, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Pandas live in China. They eat mostly bamboo and spend many hours eating each day.' What do pandas mostly eat?
maklum_balas: The text says pandas eat mostly bamboo, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct quantifier: 'There isn't ______ water in the pond.'
maklum_balas: 'Water' is uncountable, so we use 'much', making B correct.

soalan: 'Many animals are losing their habitat.' The word 'habitat' means ______.
pilihan: the natural home of an animal
maklum_balas: A habitat is the natural home of an animal, so B is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'environment', so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct quantifier: 'There are ______ birds in the forest.'
maklum_balas: 'Birds' is countable and plural, so we use 'many', making B correct.

soalan: Read: 'The sea turtle lays its eggs on the beach at night.' Where does the sea turtle lay its eggs?
maklum_balas: The text says on the beach, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct quantifier: 'We only have ______ trees left in this area, so we must protect them.'
maklum_balas: 'Trees' is countable, so 'a few' is correct, making A right.

soalan: Read: 'Rainforests give us clean air and are home to millions of animals. We must protect them.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Rainforests are important and should be protected.
maklum_balas: The text stresses rainforests are important and need protection, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: Tigers lions and bears are wild animals
Tigers, lions and bears are wild animals.
tigers, lions and bears are wild animals
Tigers lions, and bears are wild animals.
maklum_balas: Commas separate list items and the sentence needs a capital and full stop, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth. It can grow up to 30 metres long.' How long can a blue whale grow?
maklum_balas: The text states up to 30 metres, so C is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Bees are important because they help flowers and plants to grow.' Why are bees important?
maklum_balas: The text says bees help plants grow, so B is correct.

soalan: Which sentence is correct?
pilihan: There is many pollution in the city.
There is a lot of pollution in the city.
There are much pollution in the city.
There is many pollutions in the city.
maklum_balas: 'Pollution' is uncountable, so 'a lot of pollution' with 'is' is correct, making B right.

soalan: Read: 'The tiger is an endangered animal; only a few are left in the wild.' The word 'endangered' means the animal is ______.
maklum_balas: 'Endangered' means at risk of dying out, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The little turtle struggled up the beach, but it never stopped trying to reach the sea.' What does this tell us about the turtle?
maklum_balas: Never stopping trying shows the turtle is determined, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'For this experiment you need water, salt and a clear glass. Mix them slowly.' What do you mix into the water?
maklum_balas: The text says to use salt, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct future form: 'Tomorrow we ______ do a science experiment.'
maklum_balas: 'Will do' shows a future action, so A is correct.

soalan: 'First, follow each step of the procedure carefully.' The word 'procedure' means ______.
pilihan: a list of steps to do something
maklum_balas: A procedure is a set of steps to follow, so A is correct.

soalan: Which word is spelt correctly?
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'experiment', so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct prediction: 'Look at those dark clouds. I think it ______ rain.'
maklum_balas: 'Is going to rain' is a prediction from evidence, so A is correct.

soalan: Read the instruction: 'Put on your safety glasses before you start.' What must you do first?
maklum_balas: The instruction says put on safety glasses first, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the correct future form for a plan: 'Next week our class ______ visit the science museum.'
maklum_balas: With 'our class' (singular) we use 'is going to', so A is correct.

soalan: Read: 'Always clean your tools and wash your hands after an experiment to stay safe.' What is the text mainly about?
maklum_balas: The text is about staying safe after an experiment, so B is correct.

soalan: Choose the sentence with the correct order words punctuated well.
pilihan: First heat the water then add the sugar
First, heat the water. Then, add the sugar.
first heat the water then add the sugar.
First heat the water, then add the sugar
maklum_balas: Sequence words are followed by commas and each step ends with a full stop, so B is correct.

soalan: Read: 'The plant near the window grew taller than the plant in the dark box.' Which plant grew taller?
pilihan: the plant in the dark box
maklum_balas: The text says the plant near the window grew taller, so B is correct.

soalan: Read the steps: 'Measure the water. Next, pour it into the beaker. After that, record the time.' What do you do straight after pouring the water?
maklum_balas: After pouring, the next step is to record the time, so B is correct.

soalan: Which sentence correctly predicts a result?
pilihan: If we add heat, the ice will melt.
If we add heat, the ice melts yesterday.
If we add heat, the ice melted tomorrow.
If we add heat, the ice will melts.
maklum_balas: 'The ice will melt' is the correct future prediction, so A is right.

soalan: Read: 'Scientists repeat an experiment several times to make sure the result is reliable.' The word 'reliable' means the result can be ______.
maklum_balas: A reliable result is one you can trust, so B is correct.

soalan: You are writing a short story about a young inventor. Which opening sentence is the most imaginative and correct?
pilihan: In her tiny garage, Maya switched on a machine that could talk to plants.
She has a machine and it is a machine.
maklum_balas: Option B is correct, vivid and imaginative, so it is the best story opening.
